facts.c: ACLEDA Bank's Thunes service sends money abroad from the ACLEDA mobile app, in US dollars (a riel account is converted automatically)
facts.q: In case of source account in Khmer Riel, it will be automatically converted into US Dollar.
facts.note: Same list: 'You can transfer money abroad through ACLEDA mobile anytime and anywhere worldwide.' 'Currency in US Dollar.'
